in_marathi.name: Sudir
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sudir हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sudir is derived from the Sanskrit word 'su' which means 'good' and 'dir' which means 'prosperity'. It is a name that signifies good fortune and prosperity.
